## Description

Update docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml to register the navapbc/benefits-delivery-system source for the gov-benefit-flows domain, with appropriate credential notes.

## testing_mode
UPDATE

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml contains an entry for navapbc/benefits-delivery-system with: type: github-repo-private, credentials_required: true, access: internal-nava
- [ ] The entry includes a note about credentials provisioning (how to request access)
- [ ] YAML is valid and parseable
- [ ] check-corpus-schema.sh or equivalent does not error on docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registers benefit delivery sources including navapbc/benefits-delivery-system with credentials note

## Files to Modify
- docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml [UPDATE]
